## Task complete — Django #13512 (unicode in JSONField admin)

**Cause:** `JSONField.prepare_value()` in `django/forms/fields.py` called `json.dumps(value, cls=self.encoder)`. Python's `json.dumps` defaults to `ensure_ascii=True`, so when the admin renders a JSONField for editing, every non-ASCII character is escaped to `\uXXXX` (`中国` → `"\u4e2d\u56fd"`).
